title: Progressive exposure and split-testing for pinned model revisions
creator: Aisha Patel
description: Goal: Provide a safe, tenant-aware way to progressively expose new model revisions that are pinned by customers. Deliver a flexible progressive-exposure system that supports shadow testing, percentage-based traffic splits per pin, and automated rollback gates based on latency, cost, and quality regressions. This enables product teams and customers to validate model changes in production without breaking the pin contract or requiring tenant-level config churn.
acceptance_criteria: Platform exposes a per-pin progressive-exposure policy object (weights, phases, duration) editable via Console and API
Traffic routing supports three modes: shadow (no response to tenant), partial-expose (X% of real responses), and full-expose
Gating engine evaluates latency, error rate, token cost, and eval-set quality metrics to auto-pause/rollback exposure
Audit log entries and rollout timeline are recorded for each pin and visible in Console under Rollouts tab
Integrations: rollout config persisted to Private control plane and respected by Dedicated pools
rollout_plan: Phase 0: design + opt-in API (week 1). Phase 1: shadow traffic and telemetry collection for target tenants (week 2). Phase 2: 1% exposed, monitor 48h, apply gates. Phase 3: step to 5% then 25% if stable. Phase 4: full flip or preserve version as pinned. Provide manual override and immediate rollback button.
metrics_and_gates: Median p95 latency increase > 20ms triggers pause
Token cost per request increase > 12% triggers review
Error rate (5xx) relative increase > 0.5 percentage points triggers rollback
Quality regression: eval set BLEU/EMB/levenshtein drop >= configured threshold (default 2%) triggers rollback
Customer-facing correctness alerts: false-positive rate on labeled prompts exceeds threshold

2026-03-08: Security reviewed data retention for shadow logs; recommended masking PII and shorter retention for shadow payloads.
2026-03-10: PM review: add capability to bind different eval sets per tenant for quality gating. Updated design doc.
2026-03-12: UX mocks reviewed; Console team proposed a compact timeline + single-click rollback. Design aligned. Preparing for Eng PRs to land next week.
implementation_notes: Routing: implement a per-tenant weight table that composes with global routing policies
Telemetry: capture diff-buckets (baseline vs candidate) to compute relative regressions
Caching: ensure KV cache keys partition by model revision to avoid cross-variant contamination
Rollbacks: support immediate emergency rollback and automated pause with human review email
Console: expose exposure policy JSON with validation and preview of estimated token cost impact
